command.oaicopilot.openConfig.title: Open Configuration UI
command.oaicopilot.showBalances.title: Show Provider Balances
command.oaicopilot.refreshBalances.title: Refresh Provider Balances
config.oaicopilot.logLevel.description: Debug log level. Logs are written to ~/.copilot/oaicopilot/logs/ as JSON lines. Default is 'off' (no logging).
config.oaicopilot.models.description: Configured models. Model ID is unique within a provider; Display Name is globally unique.
config.oaicopilot.retry.description: Retry configuration for handling api errors like [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
config.oaicopilot.delay.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. Default is 0 (no delay).
config.oaicopilot.commitLanguage.descrip: Language for generated Git commit messages. Default is English.
config.oaicopilot.commitMessagePrompt.de: Custom system prompt for commit message generation. If not provided, uses the default prompt.
config.oaicopilot.readFileLines.descript: Number of lines to read when using `read_file` tool. Large lines may cost more tokens. Default is 0, let model decide lines.
config.oaicopilot.retry.enabled.descript: Enable retry mechanism for api errors. Default is true.
config.oaicopilot.retry.max_attempts.des: Maximum number of retry attempts. Default is 3.
config.oaicopilot.retry.interval_ms.desc: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds. Default is 1000 (1 seconds).
config.oaicopilot.retry.status_codes.des: Additional HTTP status codes that will be merged. Default is [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].
config.oaicopilot.language.description: Language of the PolyLLM configuration panel. Automatic follows the VS Code display language.
config.oaicopilot.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
